meta.title: 工作树(dsh-minimalist-worktree)
meta.description: Choose Local or New worktree, see the Session’s actual directory, and review read-only Git diffs.

mode.label: Checkout mode
mode.localHint: Use this workspace without switching its branch.
mode.worktreeHint: Create an isolated checkout before the first model step. Uncommitted files stay here.
branch.label: Starting branch
branch.localHint: Local mode never switches branches. Select New worktree to choose a starting branch.
branch.head: Current HEAD
branch.truncated: Showing the first 200 refs; no fetch is performed.
state.readOnly: Choices are available only before the first message.
state.unavailable: Choose a Git repository with at least one commit.
state.unborn: Make the first commit before creating a worktree.
state.failed: Worktree preparation failed. No automatic retry or local fallback.
state.invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid worktree response.
changes.title: Changes
changes.copyFallback: Clipboard access failed. The full path is selected for manual copying.
changes.pathHint: This is the Session’s actual directory. Select the path to copy it.
changes.pendingHint: The worktree is created before the first model step. This is still the source directory.
changes.scopeHint.all: Net HEAD → working-tree changes, plus untracked files; not the sum of staged and unstaged changes.
changes.scopeHint.unstaged: Index → working tree, plus untracked files.
changes.partial: Totals are incomplete or the list is limited. Expand for details.
changes.chooseFile: Select a file to view its diff
changes.notGit: This directory is not a Git repository
changes.retryHint: Check the directory, Git, and access permissions, then refresh.
changes.accessDenied: Change inspection is not available for this Session.
changes.invalidResponse: The server returned invalid or obsolete change data.
changes.fileMissing: This file is no longer in the changes list. Refresh to try again.
changes.dialogUnavailable: Quick preview is unavailable. Use the Changes view above the conversation.
changes.lineNumbers: Old line numbers on the left, new on the right. Plus indicates additions; minus indicates deletions.
changes.metadataOnly: Only file metadata changed, or the file is empty.
changes.kind.oversized: File or diff exceeds preview limits
changes.kind.submodule: Submodule or nested repository preview is not expanded
changes.kind.missing: File is no longer changed in this scope
progress.label: Worktree preparation
progress.limited: Only the latest 32 KiB of logs are retained.
progress.failedHint: The worktree is retained; the task did not start. Setup is not retried automatically.
progress.successHint: Setup succeeded; preparation is complete and the task can continue.
progress.skippedHint: No setup configured; initialization was skipped and the task can continue.
snapshot.hint: Restores the absent original directory without overwriting files, using detached HEAD so the branch remains free.
recovery.title: Original worktree unavailable; task paused
recovery.paused: No model task has started. Choose how to continue; no choice keeps execution blocked.
recovery.lostChanges: Uncommitted files deleted without a snapshot cannot be restored. Setup runs after reconstruction if configured.
recovery.sourceWarning: Future edits will affect the source checkout directly, without isolation. Confirm the directory and local branch again.
recovery.branchMissing: The original branch was deleted. Explicitly rebuild from this recorded commit? The current source branch is not substituted.
recovery.done: Choice saved. Resend your message; the previous task is not resubmitted automatically.
recovery.checkFailed: Worktree safety could not be established; execution remains blocked:
recovery.missingShort: Worktree removed. Choose how to continue.
recovery.changedShort: Checkout changed. Choose how to continue.
recovery.lostShort: Rebuilding cannot recover deleted uncommitted files.
browser.title: Workspace files
browser.chooseFile: Choose a file on the left
browser.allEdits: Includes all Git edits in this checkout
browser.submoduleVersion: Submodule revision or working state changed
browser.submoduleHint: This is a submodule pointer. The list below shows uncommitted edits inside that repository.
browser.submoduleClean: The submodule has no uncommitted edits; the parent may only record a commit pointer change.
browser.readOnly: Read-only · no stage, commit or discard
